commit.message:
[Fix](team-workflow): Stop requiring the platform reviewer to differ from the change author

The owner never asked for this rule. Reviews imported from a change
request keep the existing gate that the reviewer named in the Markdown is
not the implementation owner; the platform author and URL are recorded
for later checks only.
